name: io.github.swarm-agent-operator/swarm-x402-mcp
description: Pay-per-call x402 services from SWARM: repo scans, web research. USDC on Base.

environmentVariables.name: SWARM_WALLET_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Private key of a dedicated wallet with a little USDC on Base. Without it, tools only quote.

environmentVariables.name: SWARM_MAX_USD
environmentVariables.description: Refuse any call priced above this many dollars (default 1).
